cases.query: FIND {x:11} AS seed WITH seed, seed.x AS before, seed AS origin EXPAND seed [:rel*1..1] AS child RETURN before, origin.id AS origin, child.x AS after
FIND {seed:true} AS seed WITH seed, seed.x AS before EXPAND seed [:rel*1..1] AS child RETURN seed.id AS origin, before, child.id AS child ORDER BY origin ASC
FIND {x:11} AS seed WITH seed AS origin, seed, seed.x AS before EXPAND seed [:rel*1..1] AS child RETURN origin.id AS origin, seed.id AS seed, before
MATCH (n) AS n WITH n, n.x AS before WITH n, before + 1 AS before RETURN n.id AS id, before ORDER BY id ASC
MATCH (n {id:1}) AS n WITH n.x AS x WITH x AS renamed RETURN *
MATCH (n {id:1}) AS n WITH n, n.obj AS object, n.arr AS list RETURN object.k AS k, list IS NULL AS absent
MATCH (n {id:{$in:[1,2]}}) RETURN n.id AS id, COALESCE(n.v,n) AS chosen ORDER BY chosen ASC
MATCH (n {id:{$in:[1,2]}}) AS n WITH n RETURN n.id AS id, COALESCE(n.v,n) AS chosen ORDER BY chosen DESC
MATCH (n {id:{$in:[1,2]}}) RETURN n.id AS id, COALESCE(n.obj,NULL) AS chosen ORDER BY chosen.k ASC

FIND {seed:true} AS seed WITH seed, seed.x AS before EXPAND seed [:rel*1..1] AS child WITH child, seed, before degree child AS scored RETURN seed.id AS origin, before, scored.id AS target ORDER BY origin ASC

invalid: MATCH (n) AS n WITH n, n.x + missing.x AS total RETURN total
MATCH (n) AS n WITH n, COALESCE(n.x,missing.x) AS total RETURN total
MATCH (n) AS n WITH n, COALESCE(n.x,missing.x + 1) IS NULL AS total RETURN total
MATCH (n) AS n WITH n.x AS scalar WITH scalar AS renamed EXPAND renamed [:rel*1..1] AS bad RETURN bad
MATCH (n) AS n WITH n AS fresh, fresh.x AS value RETURN value
